_readme: Curated map: Minced canonical ingredient -> USDA FDC food + gram weights. A human decision, not a search result.
fdc_id: the FDC food whose per-100g nutrients we use. Prefer Foundation/SR Legacy; Branded only where SR has nothing (gochujang, harissa, garam masala).
density_g_per_ml: grams per millilitre. Used for tsp/tbsp/cup/... when set; otherwise derived (median) from the food's USDA volume portions.
unit_g: grams for ONE count unit (clove, can, fillet, head, stalk, slice, piece, portion, bunch) or 'each' (a recipe line with no unit). Beats USDA portions.
basis: which form the numbers describe (dry / raw / drained). A recipe line that means a different form is a known inaccuracy.
Anything not listed here is auto-matched by search and the recipe is flagged 'review' until someone adds it here.

spaghetti.note: Cacio e pepe weighs pasta dry; 200 g dry = 2 servings. Foundation 2758998 was tried first but its record has sodium only (macros pending), so SR Legacy is used

pecorino romano.basis: Cheese, romano (SR has no separate pecorino)

chickpeas.note: 15 oz can: 425 g net, ~240 g drained

whole tomatoes.note: 28 oz can (the usual size for whole peeled); includes the juice

garlic.note: SR Legacy chosen over Foundation 1104647 because it carries a clove portion

garam masala.note: Branded proxy; ground spice blend ~2.5 g/tsp

smoked paprika.note: SR paprika is the closest proxy; smoked paprika is nutritionally near-identical

salmon.note: recipe says 6 oz each = 170 g; USDA's own 'fillet' portion is a whole 396 g side

toasted sesame oil.note: SR 'sesame, salad or cooking' is the same fat profile

harissa paste.note: Branded proxy; label omits fibre, so fibre is under-counted

ramen noodles.note: SR has no fresh ramen; fresh egg-pasta is the nearest. 1 portion ~ 110 g (a 4 oz nest)

white miso.note: SR 'Miso' is not colour-specific; white miso is on the lower-sodium end

egg.note: 1 large; counted raw even when 'soft-boiled' (boiling adds no energy)
